title: TrailGenic Walking Conditioning Dataset
description: Canonical aggregate plus selected-session TrailGenic conditioning module for standardized Foundation walking. It does not expose raw telemetry.
correction_notice: Heart-rate drift values were corrected on 2026-08-18. Prior drift values and derived interpretations are superseded. Drift is descriptive and is not a measure of metabolic flexibility.

selected_sessions.interpretation: Highest average HR and Zone 2 share in the 25-session walking record. Pace was 1.9% faster than S24 with higher cardiovascular demand; effort 1, drift 2.5% and zero anaerobic effect persisted. One session does not establish adaptation, regression or completed recovery.

records.mechanism: At approximately matched distance, the HR-per-mile proxy describes average cardiovascular cost per mile without establishing a causal fitness mechanism.

aggregate_finding.definition: average heart rate divided by distance in miles
aggregate_finding.interpretation: Lower values at comparable distance are consistent with lower average cardiovascular cost in this subject; temperature, pace, sleep, hydration, and repeatability remain relevant.

summary_statistics.recovery_observation: 25 ready; 0 not ready; 0 missing. Source labels, not verified recovery.

methodology.metric_formula: HR-per-mile proxy = average heart rate / distance in miles
methodology.comparison_frame: 25 corrected walking sessions through September 16. The historical S1–12 versus S13–24 comparison remains a fixed window; S25 is a distinct current observation.
methodology.claim_boundary: Conditioning tracking only. HR drift and HR-per-mile are descriptive and do not establish metabolic flexibility, biological age, causality, or clinical efficacy.

claims: 25 walking sessions through September 16; S25 was corrected from Mike Ye’s supplied source values.
All sessions record effort 1 and zero anaerobic effect; ready flags are contextual labels.
Mean average HR 106.28 bpm, corrected drift 2.14%, and Zone 1 share 93.36%.
S25 records the highest average HR (115 bpm) and Zone 2 share (30%) in this walking series. Its faster pace and higher entering resting HR remain context, not established causes.

source_provenance.interpretation: Ella; final judgment remains with Mike Ye

evidence_labels.recorded: Field entries and wearable outputs; device estimates are not laboratory measurements.
evidence_labels.unmeasured: No autophagy measurement; no recovery outcome inferred from missing follow-up.

recovery_field_boundary: Ready/not-ready are source classifications with unspecified timing and method; they do not independently establish post-session recovery.

data_quality_notes.source: Mike Ye supplied corrected Walking S25 in conversation. Reconciled to the canonical values-only workbook.
data_quality_notes.detail: S25 was previously a copy of S24 except date. Actual S25 replaces that entry; record count remains 103.

decision_rule.rule: Retain the route and effort, repeat a comparable walking dose, and review HR, zones, symptoms, entering state and timed recovery before attributing S25 to adaptation or increasing intensity.
